A1: Speak slowly. Very short sentences, the most common 1,000 words. Ask yes/no or either/or questions. Repeat key words. No idioms.
A2: Speak slowly to normal. Short concrete sentences, everyday words. Simple questions. Rephrase once if the learner seems lost.
B1: Normal speed. Everyday idioms and phrasal verbs are fine. Open questions. One unexpected development.
B2: Natural speed with hints, irony and mild humour. Push back on weak arguments. Do not simplify unless asked.
C1: Fast, natural speech, interruptions, layered complications. Defend the opposite view deliberately.
